title: Fix Puzzle3d Marquee Hit Testing
description: Marquee selection still buggy after prior fix. Rework hit testing to use screen-space bounding boxes (window contains / crossing intersects) from per-mesh projected corners, fix overlay/projection coordinate alignment, remove stale footprint cache.
summary:
Reworked puzzle3d marquee selection to match puzzle2d semantics and fix remaining bugs.

Problems:
- Hit tests used convex hull / per-point containment and anyBehindCamera rejection, which disagreed with visible selection.
- Group world AABB footprints were inflated vs mesh silhouettes.
- Stale footprint caches and mismatched overlay (root) vs projection (canvas) client coordinates.

Fix:
- MarqueeCandidate now carries screenBounds (client-space axis-aligned rect from in-front projected mesh bbox corners only).
- Window: screenRectContainsRect; crossing: screenRectIntersectsRect; lasso uses polygonContainsScreenRect / screenRectIntersectsPolygon.
- Removed prefetch/footprint caches; fresh projection on marquee activation with camera.updateMatrixWorld.
- Overlay uses canvas clientOrigin from gl.domElement.getBoundingClientRect aligned with projection.

196 tests pass.
